name: octaweave_confirm_upload
description: STEP 3 OF 3 for uploading a file: turns the uploaded object into a real file row. Call it only after the PUT succeeded. Until you confirm, the object exists but the file does not — an abandoned upload expires on its own, so a failed PUT needs no cleanup. Returns the file, including its id.

workspace.description: Workspace slug or uuid. An API key is pinned to ONE workspace — call octaweave_whoami and use actor.workspace_id. A wrong workspace is a 403, not a 404.
